name: pi-web-chrome
description: Pi extension that launches or connects to Chrome via the Chrome DevTools Protocol

scripts.smoke: node --import tsx -e "import ext from './src/index.ts'; const tools=[]; const commands=[]; const pi={registerTool:t=>tools.push(t.name),registerCommand:n=>commands.push(n),on(){},registerFlag(){},getFlag(){return undefined}}; ext(pi); const expectedTools=['chrome_status','chrome_launch','chrome_connect','chrome_close','chrome_tabs','chrome_navigate','chrome_search','chrome_wait_for','chrome_snapshot','chrome_click','chrome_type','chrome_press_key','chrome_scroll','chrome_screenshot','chrome_console','chrome_network','chrome_evaluate']; const expectedCommands=['chrome']; for (const name of expectedTools) if (!tools.includes(name)) throw new Error('Missing tool '+name); for (const name of expectedCommands) if (!commands.includes(name)) throw new Error('Missing command '+name); for (const name of commands) if (name.startsWith('chrome-')) throw new Error('Unexpected legacy command '+name); console.log({tools,commands});"
